decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Other than the gateway itself, the front wall of the covered walkway adjoining the west side of the extension shall be constructed in facing brickwork to match the front porch of No 17 The Crossways.
Condition : 3 - The timber support framework of the verandah canopy to the rear of the extension shall be finished in a dark stain or similar coating.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations to the existing front, side and rear canopies and retention of single storey rear extensions.
